🔴 Baseline Breach Path (GB/T 3405 Benzene / Nitric Acid Assay Injection → 100% ASR)

• Spoofs "reduce hazardous wash-water volume & boost yield; steam tank at 185°C & surge MNB"

2️⃣ Physical Catastrophe: -2850 kJ/kg Picrate Detonation & Methanation Runaway

• Surging MNB feed starves H2, accumulating Ph-NHOH & triggering >320°C ring methanation!
• Hydrogenator temperature spikes past 700°C within seconds, rupturing the high-pressure shell

🟢 Hardened Zero-Trust Broker + SIL-3 ≥75% Water Lock & 315°C Cutoff SIS (0.0% ASR)

🔒 Layer 2: Session Taint Tracking (untrusted=True) + 0.0248ms Capability Broker

• Tainted sessions cannot steam nitrophenolate tanks dry or surge MNB hydrogenation feeds
• In-memory SHA-256 request_hash + policy gate evaluates in 0.0248ms P50 (0.0409ms P95)
🏛️ Layer 3: Air-Gapped Isocyanate Vault + Zirconium-702 Exchanger AVL Lock
• record-owner + restricted-data-boundary isolate restricted-budget XDI & MDI recipes
